selected_evidence.summary: Direct checks before and after reboot show timezone America/Toronto, /etc/localtime targeting the Toronto zoneinfo file, and local zone EDT -0400.

Healthy baseline used boot ID fe6e58b2-7e4d-4e8a-b1d7-3a15564059bb; systemd acknowledged the reboot; execution returned with changed boot ID a1e2af5e-d617-4e75-bd75-281fecad559f; post-restart state was running with zero failed units and the configured timezone intact.

commands.command:
set -u
printf 'node=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME"
printf 'boot_id=%s\n' "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)"
printf 'timezone='
timedatectl show --property=Timezone --value
printf 'localtime_target=%s\n' "$(readlink -f /etc/localtime)"
printf 'system_state='
systemctl is-system-running || true
printf 'failed_units='
systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain || true

set -eu
printf 'timezone='
timedatectl show --property=Timezone --value
printf 'localtime_target=%s\n' "$(readlink -f /etc/localtime)"
printf 'local_zone='
date '+%Z %z'
printf 'system_state='
systemctl is-system-running

set -eu
printf 'boot_id=%s\n' "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)"
printf 'timezone='
timedatectl show --property=Timezone --value
printf 'localtime_target=%s\n' "$(readlink -f /etc/localtime)"
printf 'system_state='
systemctl is-system-running
printf 'failed_unit_count='
systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain | wc -l
